role: TGA packages preserve Trust Graph essay-derived governance pressure and project runtime assurance surfaces into TIS v0.12.0 executable artifact contracts when external validation, registry publication, or assurance review is required.

maps.notes: TGA graph surfaces can identify the TSMM runtime governance envelope being projected.
TGA controls describe the governance pressure; TIS records the artifact-level authority boundary.
Runtime evidence belongs in TIS-compatible bundles, not in essay provenance.
TGA package evaluations can be recorded as externally reviewable evaluation envelopes.
TGA decision examples should remain mappable to TIS decision receipts when relied on across repositories.
Registry publication is discoverability evidence, not runtime authorization.
